title: Example: Mnemuron Dynamic Task Scope v0.1
goal: Example task: validate persistent task binding after an explicitly confirmed Resume while preserving the destination workstream.
decisions: The confirmed Resume Packet supplies project_id and task_id; the destination Adapter supplies workstream_id.
A Resume Packet is injected once, but its activated Task Scope persists for later turns in the same conversation.
The confirmation turn remains on the previous scope; activation starts only at the next ordinary user turn.
A newer confirmed Resume supersedes the prior active binding only within the matching conversation scope.
Local binding records use 0700 directories, 0600 files, and include Resume provenance in captured raw events.
blockers: Example seed only; deployment-specific acceptance evidence has not been recorded.
next_steps: Configure isolated service and client identities for this example.
Run the documented acceptance checks and record actual results before marking the task complete.
